desc:
• FUDGIER BROWNIES: Bake a mouthwatering dessert with this mix that makes chewy, fudgier brownies, thanks to an updated baking temp

  • TRIPLE CHOCOLATE DECADENCE IN ONE: Sink your sweet tooth into these supremely delicious brownies with chocolate chunks and chips

  • QUICK AND EASY: Make a family favorite treat by simply adding a few ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

  • DAY BRIGHTENING BROWNIES: Spark some joy on special occasions; Sweeten up your everyday, or bake some for office treats, parties, and celebrations

  • CONTAINS: One box of Betty Crocker Delights Supreme Triple Chunk Brownie Mix, 16 servings, 17.8 oz
features:
Key Features

Triple Chocolate Combo
Loaded with both chocolate chips and chunky chocolate pieces for maximum indulgence.

Fudgy, Chewy Texture
Delivers the perfect balance between moist center and crisp edges.

Simple Prep
Just add water, oil, and eggs—mix and bake in under 5 minutes of prep time.

Generous Size (17.8 oz)
Makes up to 16 brownies—great for families, bake sales, or gatherings.

Consistent Results
Delivers rich flavor and perfect texture every time. 

Benefits 

Intensely Chocolatey
Perfect for anyone craving a deep, satisfying chocolate dessert.

Beginner-Friendly
No baking experience needed—just follow the simple instructions on the box.

Crowd-Pleaser
Ideal for parties, school functions, or cozy nights in with family or friends.

Customizable
Can be enhanced with nuts, caramel, peanut butter, or fruit to match your taste.

Highly Rated
Loved by consumers for its flavor, ease of preparation, and bakery-quality results.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips and Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, natural flavor, soy lecithin), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Salt, Carob Powder.
